info.name: Abhinay — Auth, Profiles & Casting (WBS 1.1, 1.2)
info.description:
Abhinay API: authentication, RBAC and professional profiles (WBS 1.1), plus casting role posting and discovery (WBS 1.2.1, 1.2.2.1).

Setup
1. Import `abhinay.local.postman_environment.json` and select it.
2. Start the API: `npm run dev:backend`.
3. Run `Auth / Register` — it stores `accessToken` and `profileId` in the environment automatically.

Notes
- No credentials or tokens are bundled. `email` and `password` come from the environment; set your own before running.
- Postman keeps the HttpOnly `refreshToken` cookie in its cookie jar, so Refresh and Logout work without any manual copying.
- `X-Abhinay-Client: web` is set at collection level because the cookie-authenticated endpoints require it.
- Requests sent from Postman have no `Origin` header, which the API treats as a non-browser client.
- The Casting folder registers its own throwaway producer and stores its token in `producerAccessToken`.

item.name: Casting
item.description:
WBS 1.2.1 casting role posting and 1.2.2.1 browse & search. Producers and directors post; everyone signed in browses. Run the folder in order: it registers its own throwaway producer.

Note: registering the producer replaces the refresh cookie in Postman's cookie jar. Run `Auth / Login` again before `Auth / Refresh` if you need the main account's session back.

request.description: A fresh throwaway PRODUCER for this folder. The email is generated per run; the password reuses the environment `password`.

  "compensation": "₹15,000 per shooting day",
